title: Oyatie Cloud control-plane operation contract for resource registry and long-running operations
purpose: Hardens the metadata-level domain contract for declarative resource registry entries, operation ledger rows, idempotent retries, safe cancellation, compensation, and per-resource state transitions before any runtime reconciler or provider actuation work.

can_claim_now: Oyatie Cloud has a proposed machine-readable control-plane operation contract for registry and ledger semantics.
The contract connects every G002 resource contract to state-transition metadata and long-running-operation requirements.

stages.role: Authenticate principal, evaluate Cedar decision, enforce rate/quota admission, emit typed operation request, and return operation reference.
Persist desired resource state, generation, tenant/account/project scope, region/cell placement, and policy/quota/billing/audit bindings.
Persist durable long-running operation state with idempotency key, request hash, retry/cancel/compensation metadata, and audit-chain linkage.
Metadata boundary for future reconciler workers: compare desired and observed generations, schedule retry/backoff, mark waits, and emit drift signals.
Boundary marker only: later implementation may attach dogfood-controlled adapters after G004-G007 evidence; this G003 contract records intent envelopes only.
writes: adapter intent envelope only after later gates

pipeline.ordering_invariant: Requests move in order through API gateway, registry, operation ledger, workflow/reconciler metadata boundary, then backend actuation boundary; no stage may skip the ledger.

generation_rules: desired_generation increments exactly once for each accepted mutating request
observed_generation advances only after reconciler evidence records progress
identity_rules: resource_orn remains stable across lifecycle states
tenant/account/project and region/cell scope are immutable after create acceptance unless a later migration operation is explicitly modeled

identity.operation_id: globally unique opaque id returned to callers
identity.idempotency_key: caller-supplied or gateway-derived key scoped to tenant/account/project, principal, action, resource ORN, and request hash
identity.request_hash: canonical hash of the request envelope used to reject mismatched idempotency replays

durability.replay_source_of_truth: operation ledger plus resource registry desired state

transition_rules: Every transition appends an audit event with previous state, next state, reason, actor, and monotonic sequence.
Terminal states are immutable; compensation after a terminal failure is modeled as an explicit superseding operation that references the prior operation id, not as mutation of the terminal operation.
Cancel requests are best-effort before irreversible side effects; this metadata contract records the boundary but does not perform external changes.
Compensation starts from a non-terminal running operation when observed side effects require repair; failed remains terminal and cannot mutate into compensation.

idempotency.same_key_same_hash: return existing operation id and current state
idempotency.same_key_different_hash: reject with conflict and emit audit event
idempotency.expired_key: requires retention policy and explicit replay decision

retry_policy.max_attempts: resource-type policy field; defaults to deny unbounded retries

compensation.recording: A compensation operation is a superseding operation id that references the terminal original operation id and affected resource generation.

common_preconditions: deletion retention policy present for destructive operations

create: resource ORN reserved before operation ack
delete: retention marker written before terminal deletion state
suspend: billing and SLO effects recorded as metadata
purge: requires deletion retention expiry evidence and explicit audit reason

nonclaims.statement: This contract stops at registry, ledger, and adapter-boundary metadata; external execution is blocked until later evidence exists.
No reconciler worker or operation-ledger persistence runtime is asserted by this artifact.
Launch language remains blocked until later quality and SLO gates are green.
Tenant migration remains blocked until substrate, policy, observability, and CI evidence are complete.

doubt_driven_review.challenge: Operation-contract metadata could be mistaken for a running control plane.
doubt_driven_review.resolution: Claim controls and validator enforce metadata-only status, adapter-boundary-only scope, no runtime reconciler claim, required ledger/idempotency/cancel semantics, and full G002 resource-contract coverage.
doubt_driven_review.residual_risk: G004-G007 must still bind policy/billing/audit, measured SLO evidence, production quality kits, and dogfood CI before runtime claims are safe.
